validated_constraints: Massive particles remain subluminal in standard special relativity.
Near-c speed is not a meaningful stand-alone high-energy performance target.
Circular, linear, plasma, strong-field, and astrophysical contexts require different constraint assumptions.
required_invariants: Do not state or imply that a massive particle reaches or exceeds c.
Do not convert a future design projection into an observed result.
Treat every proposed numerical threshold as a sensitivity-tested input, not a discovery.
recommended_problem_reframing: When a massive particle is already ultra-relativistic, which energy, rigidity, loss, power, beam-quality, and protection constraint actually determines the credible frontier of each accelerator architecture?
